The '''Wookiee dropship''' was a troop-carrying air vehicle used by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:RepCom_wookieedropship2.png|thumb|left|200px|A Wookiee dropship from the rear]]

The [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] was powered by four propellers mounted on each side of two thrusters and could fit several [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warriors in compartments underneath an airship-like frame. The ship had two forward-facing guns for defense.

==History==
In the lead-up to the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], these craft were used to ferry Wookiee resistance fighters.

[[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] was told to help the Wookiees in one of their [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bays]] but when they got there the dropship was taking off. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who had battled Delta Squad the previous day, arrived in his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. Grievous raced towards them and destroyed the dropship that had just taken off. No Wookiees survived and Grievous flew off leaving his bodyguards to finish the job.
